details.detail: Overall massing and layout: the 1.30 m shell, 2.20 m length, the wardrobe on the aisle side, the console on the window side, the angled aisle pier and the lowered centre divider now match omaat_f7, f1, f3 and f5.

Wall caps. The squared 0.06 caps are better than the old bullnose. Two things are still wrong. The caps have sharp plan corners, while f8 shows a rounded inner L-corner (radius about 0.08). The forward aisle corner has only a flat 0.06 slab on a 0.04 wall, while f4 and f47 show a thick cantilevered hood there that overhangs both the aisle and the pier. In studio light the fCap #8a8272 cap also reads cream against the #69655f shell.

Seat niche with its jambs, header and two domes: verified against f9, f46 and f1 (good). The domes render as glowing white discs. In every daytime photo they are black eyeball spots with a chrome ring and no light on.

Seat back and headrest flap. The back is taller and more upright (fixed), and the flap tone is right: 1.25x the back, cool, against f9 #92938d / #7e776f. The flap is wrong in position and shape. It floats as an inset pane with 3.5 cm of back fabric above it and a shadow line all round, so it reads as a window or glass screen. In f9, f1, f5 and f8 the flap hangs from the top edge of the back and wraps over it.

Seat cushion, leg rest and fabric: the warm grey with no mauve is right (fFabric #6c655d vs f9 back #7e776f), and the leg rest is flush. Under cabin light the back renders about 2.5x darker than the cushion (studio #49433d vs #b6aca0); f9 shows only 1.26x. That is mostly lighting.
Lilac pillow. It is a rigid rounded slab with no taper and no woven check pattern. Its colour is fine.

Window console. The taupe fascia over a near-black body with a floor grille is now verified (f7 lower body #161612). The wood tray, keypad and handset dock are fine. The tray is slightly cool and dark (#383534 in q02 vs f47 #4d3e2e warm).

Screen wall. The screen, the stowed table and the angled pier are right. The pill mirror renders #2c3649 near-black navy and reads as a second screen or phone; f10 shows #5b6680, reflecting its surroundings. The window wing is a flat 0.08 strip, while f10 and f47 show a wider wing whose upper outer corner curves toward the window.

Centre pair. The divider is lowered, as in f1, f3, f4 and f5. The angled dark-wood fins between the two centre screens are missing: f4 and f3 show them in rows 1 and 2 as a V in plan, full screen-wall height, projecting about 0.25-0.30 m aft. c_top and q02 show only a thin taupe joint there.

Aisle exterior door leaves. They are now equal at 0.50, the dark-wood fixed panel is added, and the silver kick line is right. The stiles are too thin: 0.035 against about 0.06, since the pb_20 frame is 100 of 815 px. Rib count is about 18 against 23 per leaf, and the grooves are shallow and narrow (29 % of the pitch). The pb_20 profile gives about 45 % dark fraction, and f4 and f7 show rounded ribs with strong shadows. In s6 the leaves read as a flat, low-contrast slat texture.
Ottoman and void. The cantilevered bench over a dark void matches f10 and pb_30 (fixed).

Bed mode. The pad, duvet with a turned fold, white and lilac pillows and the table over the foot are plausible against f46 and f47. The duvet has no drape or sateen stripe, and the pillow is still a slab. The sun blotches in q04 belong to the lighting area.

Seat plaque. The lit blue-violet text fix does NOT show: q02 renders white '2G' on a raised dark tile. The real plaque is a pill-shaped slot recessed into the taupe cap, slightly darker than the cap, with blue-lit text (f9, f7, f8).

issues.problem: The blue-violet plaque text fix is a no-op, and the plaque is a raised dark tile instead of a recessed taupe slot
issues.detail: 09_seats.js sets c:'#8f9cff' on an atlasGlow (layer 15) material. The shader (04_shaders.js line 91) ignores the base colour for layers 13-15 (emissive = tc * gain, base = tc*0.04), so the atlas text colour '#efe7da' (06_atlas.js) is what shows: white. The plate is #2b2b2e and stands 4 mm proud.
issues.evidence: q02: white '2G' on a dark grey tile. omaat_f9 crop: a recessed rounded slot the colour of the cap, with blue-violet glowing 'K'. f7 and f8 show the same.
issues.fix: In 06_atlas.js, draw F-class tags with fillStyle '#8f9cff' for the text and a bg close to the lit slot tone (about '#6d665c'), or multiply tc by base for layer 15. In 09_seats.js, make the suite plate gRBox(0.034,0.002,0.075,0.012,1) colour '#7a7266' (slightly darker than fCap), sunk flush (p[1] - 0.001) with the glyph quad 0.5 mm above it. This touches shared files, so coordinate with the integrator.

issues.problem: The headrest flap floats as an inset pane and reads as a window or screen
issues.detail: 09d_suite.js: gRBox(0.52,0.18,0.02) at BH y=0.60 on a back 0.725 tall leaves 3.5 cm of back above it and back fabric round every side. It sits 0.046 proud as a stiff slab.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9, f1, f5 and f8: the slate flap starts at the very top edge of the back and wraps over it (the fold shows in f8). It is about 77 % of the back width and 27 % of its height. seat_front and s4 renders show a glass-like panel mid-back.
issues.fix: Set the flap centre to BH y = 0.725 - 0.10 = 0.625 and use gRBox(0.56, 0.20, 0.012, 0.006, 1). Add a wrap-over piece: gRBox(0.56, 0.012, 0.07, 0.006, 1) at BH (0, 0.727, -0.005), fFlap. Drop the -2 deg tilt so it lies on the back surface (z = -0.041).

issues.problem: The dark-wood fins between the two centre screens are missing
issues.detail: With center=true, wing=0.0, so the screen butts the divider and only the taupe divider edge shows between 1D and 1G.
issues.evidence: omaat_f4 (1D/1G) and omaat_f3 (2D/2G): an angled dark straight-grain wood fin at the divider end of each centre screen, full screen-wall height, projecting about 0.25-0.3 m aft, so the pair forms a V. omaat_f5 shows them from the seat side.
issues.fix: In suiteUnit when center: add B.add(gRBox(0.02, H - 0.62, 0.28, 0.006, 1), M4.trs(-hx + 0.03, 0.62 + (H - 0.62)/2, -L + 0.27, 20*DEG), SEATMAT.fWood), angled so its aft end leans toward the seat. Add a thin taupe edge cap gRBox(0.03, 0.02, 0.29, ...) at the top. If width allows, shift scx inward by 0.02.

issues.problem: The forward aisle corner has no cantilevered hood
issues.detail: The front outer wall is only 0.04 thick, with cap(0.04, 0.50) on top. In the aisle views (q02 right, s1) this corner reads as a thin fence.
issues.evidence: omaat_f4: at both the left and right aisle corners of each screen end, a thick rounded taupe hood about 0.12 wide and 0.08 thick with a curved end overhangs the aisle and the pier. omaat_f47 top-left: the same hood seen from inside, curving over the pier and lamp. omaat_f8 shows the rounded L-corner of the caps in plan.
issues.fix: Replace cap(0.04, 0.50, hx - 0.02, H, -L + 0.35) with a hood: gRBox(0.13, 0.08, 0.34, 0.03, 3) at (hx - 0.045, H + 0.02, -L + 0.22), fCap, plus a downturned end lip gRBox(0.13, 0.10, 0.03, 0.015, 2) at z = -L + 0.05. Round the cap plan corners where the wardrobe cap meets the aft-wall cap with a quarter-disc filler (gCyl r 0.08, h 0.06) at the inner corner.

issues.problem: The aisle-door rib panel is too flat and fine, and the stiles are too thin
issues.detail: Stiles and rails are 0.035. Ribs are gBox 0.017 on a 0.024 pitch (~18 per leaf) standing 0.008 proud, which gives low groove contrast in s6 and q02.
issues.evidence: The pb_20 closed leaves show 23 grooves per leaf, a frame about 12 % of the leaf width (~0.06 m) and a ~45 % dark groove fraction. omaat_f4 and f7 show convex ribs with strong shading.
issues.fix: Stile/rail 0.035 to 0.055 (move the rib run in by 0.02). Pitch 0.024 to 0.019, rib 0.011 wide with gRBox(0.010, H-0.34, 0.011, 0.004, 1) for rounded faces, depth 0.010. Darken fFluteGap to about '#221e1a'.

issues.problem: The pill mirror reads as a black-navy screen
issues.detail: The mirror material is { c:'#6f7f98', r:0.1, m:0.6 }, but it renders #2c3649 because it reflects the dark environment and has little diffuse.
issues.evidence: omaat_f10 mirror #5b6680, reflecting the wood and cabin, on a grey rim. up_forward_look shows the same.
issues.fix: Use { c:'#8593a8', r:0.18, m:0.25 } (more diffuse) for the pane, and make its rim fCap rather than fShell so it separates from the wood.

issues.problem: The reading-lamp domes glow white when they should be off
issues.detail: The niche domes and the pier lamp use SEATMAT.lampGlow discs of r 0.015/0.013.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9, f1, f5 and f46: black eyeball spots with a chrome ring, the lens dark.
issues.fix: Replace the lampGlow disc with a chrome ring gCyl(0.02,0.02,0.004) { c:'#9a9894', m:0.9, r:0.3 } plus a dark lens { c:'#1b1b1c', r:0.2 }. Keep lampGlow only for an explicit 'light on' state.

issues.problem: The window-side screen wing is a flat 0.08 strip
issues.detail: The wing is a flat gRBox(0.068, 0.62, 0.03).
issues.evidence: omaat_f10 and f47: the window wing is about 0.12-0.14 wide, and its upper outer corner sweeps round toward the window in a taupe-edged curve, above a small shelf at the console end (water bottle in f47).
issues.fix: Widen to 0.11 where w allows, use gRBox(..., r 0.06, seg 3) so the upper outer corner is visibly round, and add a 0.12 x 0.02 x 0.14 fCap shelf at y 0.70 at the console's forward end.

issues.problem: The pillow is a rigid slab
issues.detail: The pillow uses cushionSecs(0.44, 0.1, 0.30...) with edge 0.04, so it has near-constant thickness and square shoulders.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9 and f5: a plump pillow tapering to thin pointed corners, with a woven diamond/check texture.
issues.fix: Loft it with 3 sections: thickness 0.03 at the edges and 0.12 in the middle, corner radius 0.02. Give it layer LAYER.yDiamond (or a subtle check) at low gain.

issues.problem: The console tray wood is slightly cool and dark
issues.evidence: omaat_f47 tray #4d3e2e warm dark wood with stripes; the q02 tray is #383534 and reads as a vent grille.
issues.fix: Give the tray its own material, about '#4a3d33', LAYER.fWood, leaving fShelf for the table.

questionsForUser: Can you share or confirm a photo of the centre-pair screen end at eye level? f4 and f3 show angled dark-wood fins between the D and G screens. Are they fixed, or part of the raisable divider?
The aisle door stiles look light taupe in omaat_f4 and f7 but darker than the ribs in pb_20 (at night). Which do you prefer to match?
